A much more compact settings popup.

### Changed
- **Condensed popup:** about 300px tall instead of 760, at the same width, with the same switches. The tagline, section headings and row descriptions are gone. Hover over a setting for a short explanation.
- **Refresh is an icon** next to the version at the top. It spins while refreshing and shows a tick when done.
- **The redirect choice fits on one row:** "On a match: Redirect / Show button".

Everything else is as in [0.5.5](https://github.com/josh345rtfvqw/detour/releases/tag/v0.5.5).

**Install:** [Chrome Web Store](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/detour/lofobnkomhhicgcpejnlcibekkaiaeed), [Firefox Add-ons](https://addons.mozilla.org/firefox/addon/detour-nebula-floatplane/), or load the zip below.
